title: Announcement channels in Caducus, with an X adapter, wired to publishing
description:
Part of the scheduled publishing and announcements epic. Design: docs/plans/scheduled-publishing-and-announcements.md ("Through Caducus: yes", "What triggers an announcement", "Exactly once").

Goal: an announcement is a Caducus kind delivered on a new `x` channel to the site's connected account (a `broadcast` recipient class), with the post id and cost on the delivery; Papyrus hands it over from the existing publish hook and from rating changes.

Caducus side (needs a Caducus issue and release; Caducus is read-only from this plan): `x` channel (post, delete, read recent posts for unknown outcomes), `broadcast` recipient class (a site channel account, not a Person), `cost` on deliveries, a token-provider interface so the host stores tokens (Papyrus: SSM SecureString). Papyrus side: announcement row keyed `<accountId>#<lineageId>` (conditional put), states drafted/awaiting approval/approved/posting/posted/failed/blocked/withdrawn, text in S3; eligibility evaluated on first publish (publish_alerts.py) and on rating change; posting claim with an attempt id; rate-limit waits read X's reset header; no blind retry after an unknown outcome. Other channels (Bluesky, Mastodon, LinkedIn, Slack) are later Caducus adapters.

Depends on: Caducus release with the above; the notifications plugin deployed on the site (MoM launches on Caducus per PPY-824c14). Relates to PPY-824c14.

```gherkin
Feature: A qualifying Story is announced once on the publication's X account
  Readers who follow the publication on X should hear about each Story worth
  their time, once, as soon as it qualifies.

  Background:
    Given MoM has announcements on, an X account connected and approval set to automatic
    And MoM announces Articles rated 5 stars

  Scenario: A Story rated before it is published is announced when it goes live
    Given an Article rated 5 stars
    When it is first published
    Then one post is made on MoM's X account with a link to the Article
    And the announcement records the post id, the time and the cost

  Scenario: A Story rated after it is published is announced when it is rated
    Given a published Article rated 4 stars
    When an editor rates it 5 stars
    Then one post is made for it

  Scenario: A new version does not announce again
    Given an announced Article
    When a corrected version is published
    Then no new post is made

  Scenario: Unpublishing and publishing again does not announce twice
    Given an announced Article that was taken down and published again
    Then there is still only one post for it

  Scenario: An unknown outcome is checked before trying again
    Given the request to X timed out
    When the announcement is retried
    Then MoM's recent posts are read first
    And if the post is there it is recorded as posted and not sent again

  Scenario: X asks us to wait
    Given X answers that the rate limit is reached until 10:15
    Then the announcement waits until 10:15 and then posts

  Scenario: A refused post is shown, not hidden
    Given X refuses the post with a message
    Then the announcement is marked failed with X's message
    And editors see it in the announcements list
```

Open questions: whether the Caducus `x` channel ships in the next Caducus minor release (file the Caducus issue first).
